# Security policy

Please report suspected vulnerabilities privately to
[laurent@bindschaedler.com](mailto:laurent@bindschaedler.com). Do not open a
public issue until the report has been acknowledged and a disclosure plan has
been agreed.

Include the affected platform and scode version, the smallest reproducible
command or repository, the observed policy bypass, and its security impact.
Avoid including live credentials or unrelated personal data.

Security fixes are supported on the latest released version. The project will
acknowledge a complete report as soon as practical, validate it, coordinate a
fix and release, and credit reporters who want attribution.
